fields.body_md:
## At a glance

The Australian National University (ANU) is a public university in Canberra, the capital of Australia. This page uses its two-year Master of Computing to show real costs and entry rules.

The most important fact is the entry rule. ANU ranks applicants, so meeting the rules does not guarantee a place. Its international page also gives a closing date of **15 December 2026** for Semester 1, 2027.

| | Master of Computing |
|---|---|
| Campus | Canberra, in person |
| Length | 2 years full time |
| Intakes | Semester 1 and Semester 2 dates are on the international page |
| Indicative fee for a full year, 2027 | **AUD 57,640** |
| GPA needed (7-point scale) | **5.0** |
| English test (IELTS) | **6.5** overall, no part below **6.0** |
| CRICOS course code | 078940M |

CRICOS is the Australian government list of courses that may teach overseas students. ANU counts 48 units as a standard year.

## What it really costs

The fee is only one part of the money. The Australian student visa asks you to show enough money for three things. They are your first-year course fee, 12 months of living costs and your travel. Read the [Australia proof of funds guide](/study-abroad/study-in/australia/australia-student-visa-proof-of-funds) for the full rules.

The sums below use the Home Affairs figures: living costs of **AUD 29,710** and travel of **AUD 2,000**. The student visa charge is **AUD 2,500**.

| Item | Master of Computing |
|---|---|
| First-year course fee, 2027 | AUD 57,640 |
| Living costs for 12 months (visa rule) | AUD 29,710 |
| Travel (visa rule) | AUD 2,000 |
| **Money to show for the visa** | **AUD 89,350** |
| Student visa charge | AUD 2,500 |
| **Total before health cover** | **AUD 91,850** |

At ₹61.80 per AUD, the totals are **₹56.76 lakh**. The rate is the Reserve Bank of Australia rate for 27 November 2026. It changes every day, so use the [rupee transfer calculator](/study-abroad/tools/rbi-lrs-tcs-calculator) before you send money.

Two limits apply to these totals. ANU gives no whole-course fee and no amount for its Services and amenities fee. We also found no official price for health cover (OSHC).

## Ways to reduce the cost

ANU's program page says it offers a wide range of scholarships. It also says eligibility depends on the scholarship. We did not confirm a scholarship for Indian students in this master's course, so we list none.

Check the ANU scholarships website before you apply. Do not count on a fee cut until you hold an offer letter that states one.

See our [Australia scholarships page](/study-abroad/study-in/australia/scholarships).

## Getting in

The Master of Computing takes a bachelor degree with a grade point average (GPA) of **5.0** on a 7-point scale. A GPA is your average grade across your degree. It also takes a **4.0** GPA with 3 years of related full-time work. ANU says admission is competitive and ranks applicants, so meeting the rule does not guarantee a place.

**English.** IELTS **6.5** overall with no part below **6.0**.

**Agent.** ANU says its agents can help you apply. It does not say you must use one.

## Deadlines

ANU's international page says Semester 1, 2027 applications close on **15 December 2026**. It says Semester 2, 2027 applications close on **15 May 2027**. The dates may differ for programs with extra selection criteria. The application fee is **AUD 150** for each application.

## Popular programs for Indian students

- [Master of Computing at ANU](/study-abroad/program-detail/australia/australian-national-university/anu-master-of-computing). Two years in Canberra. For graduates from any background.

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- you want a computing master's and your degree is in another subject
- you hold a **5.0** GPA on a 7-point scale
- you can show AUD 89,350 for the visa

**Think carefully if:**

- your marks are close to the limit, because ANU ranks applicants
- you want a scholarship, because we could not confirm one
- you cannot cover a second year at a fee that is not published

## Sources

Checked on 28 November 2026:

- [Master of Computing (7706XMCOMP), 2027, Australian National University](https://programsandcourses.anu.edu.au/2027/program/7706xmcomp). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [International undergraduate and postgraduate applications, ANU](https://study.anu.edu.au/apply/international-applications). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [English language admission requirements policy, ANU](https://policies.anu.edu.au/ppl/document/ANUP_000408) and [English language requirements, ANU](https://www.anu.edu.au/study/apply/english-language-requirements). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Student visa (subclass 500), Department of Home Affairs](https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/student-500). Checked on 28 November 2026.
- [Exchange rates, Reserve Bank of Australia](https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/frequency/exchange-rates.html). Checked on 28 November 2026.

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much does a master's at ANU cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: ANU lists an annual indicative fee of AUD 57,640 for the 2027 Master of Computing. It gives no whole-course fee.

faq_json.q: How much money must I show for the Australian student visa to study at ANU?
faq_json.a: The sum is AUD 89,350: the AUD 57,640 fee, AUD 29,710 living costs and AUD 2,000 travel. The visa charge is AUD 2,500 on top.

faq_json.q: What marks do I need for a master's at ANU?
faq_json.a: A GPA of 5.0 on a 7-point scale, or 4.0 with 3 years of related full-time work. ANU ranks applicants, so meeting the rule does not guarantee a place.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score does ANU need?
faq_json.a: IELTS 6.5 overall with no part below 6.0. ANU does not accept online or at-home IELTS results.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for the 2027 intake at ANU?
faq_json.a: Semester 1, 2027 applications close on 15 December 2026. Semester 2, 2027 applications close on 15 May 2027.

faq_json.q: Do Indian students need an agent to apply to ANU?
faq_json.a: No. ANU says its agents can help you apply, but it does not say you must use one.
